correctness.rationale: PASS. Volkmann Proposition 11(ii) states gamma_rI(K_mn)=4 for m,n≥2. Restoring the deleted matching preserves feasibility for any restrained Italian label function, giving lower bound ≥4 on Cr_n. A pair a_i,b_i labeled2 and all others0 is feasible at n≥4: each zero sees an opposite 2 and the zeros induce Cr_{n−1}, minimum degree n−2≥2. For any weight4 feasible function, each shore has a zero or the zero-induced other shore has isolated vertices; hence indexed defender inequalities force each shore weight exactly2. At weight2 per shore zero indices must coincide, and both side labels equal: vector z with sum z=2, either one index2 or two indices1. Conversely both patterns give zero induced Cr_{n−s} with s≤2, no isolated zero for n≥4 (Cr2 is a disjoint two-edge graph), and each zero sees total opposite label2. Thus gamma=4 and exactly n+binom(n,2) minima. Independent bounded-weight exhaustive enumeration n4..7 matches 10,15,21,28; Cr3 count3 is correctly excluded. The complete proof is not reliant on sampled enumeration.

originality.rationale: Best-of-knowledge PASS for the exact crown minimum-function structure and n(n+1)/2 census. Volkmann 2023 Proposition 11(ii), checked in complete original PDF, already supplies gamma_rI(K_nn)=4 and hence a lower bound for crown by monotonicity; it does not supply crown equality or all minimizing functions. Samadi et al.'s founding 2020/2021 original full available version treats complexity, trees and general extremes without crown family. A Resultary published restrained-dominating-set profile of crowns concerns unweighted ordinary restrained domination (gamma_r=2), not restrained Italian weighted labels. A perfect Roman crown result has n paired-2 optima but does not cover the additional binom(n,2) paired-1 Italian functions. Existing complete multipartite formulas are not crown theorems. No exact same-object classification found in real searches; nonindexed restatements remain possible.
residual_risks: Unindexed alternate restrained Roman-{2} crown formulation may have the same count despite bounded searches.
The scalar equality 4 is close to the elementary complete-bipartite monotonicity result; value attributed to full optimizer structure, not rediscovery of scalar four.
